d466042e.text:
Mr. Alexston of Stormwind,

I must congratulate you on the long journey restoring the city of Stormwind. Many whose path crosses Auberdine speak well of its grandeur and sound foundations. It is this success that bid me send you this message.

Auberdine has found its place in this world by the sea. Where we were once isolated, we now find hope carried by the very winds that batter our shores.

This courier represents one such traveler the winds bore to me. I hope that they may aid your people as they have mine.

In return, I ask that you might send supplies and labor to Auberdine, such that we might bolster the city against the wrath of this world that has taken so much from us.

-- Thundris Windweaver, Elder of Auberdine
d466042e.title: Thundris' Letter

10877|6c0228ac.name: Courier Hammerfall
10877|6c0228ac.text: Your legacy precedes you, $c. If you wish, I can allow you to rewrite that legacy into something new.

10877|dc8290dc.name: Courier Hammerfall
10877|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

1139|a75e2b6f.name: Magistrate Bluntnose
1139|a75e2b6f.text: Well hello there, citizen. The name's Bluntnose, Magistrate Bluntnose, to be precise. I'm charged with overseeing the well-being of Thelsamar, and believe you me, we could always use another strong set of arms around here!

1246|17a4c927.name: Vosur Brakthel
1246|17a4c927.text: Och, there's nothing I can teach ye, $N. Have a word with Tally Berryfizz over there. She can hardly reach the tables, but when she starts brewing a potion, watch out!

12656|307aaccf.name: Thamarian
12656|307aaccf.text:
On the northern dock, you can board a ship that will carry you to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus. From the southern dock, you can find passage across the Great Sea to Menethil Harbor on Khaz Modan, and onwards to Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. If you head to the western dock, you can board a ship setting sail for Stormwind.

Safe journeys to you!

12657|6231de28.name: Don Pompa
12657|6231de28.text:
This dock here? Well, you can catch the ship that goes to Southshore, and then stops at that night elf place after. What's its name? Uhh... Auberdine, I think.

I don't really know for sure, I just load and unload stuff.

12658|aaa34cd7.name: Adam Lind
12658|aaa34cd7.text: You can find passage to Theramore from this dock.  Heed my words, those lands are rarely safe to travel for people of the Alliance.  Watch your step and your back.

1470|5642b3b8.name: Ghak Healtouch
1470|5642b3b8.text: Ye're beyond my skill to teach, $N. Go pester Tally Berryfizz; she's a $r living in Tinker Town of Ironforge. Oh, and since you're headed up anyway, give Kali my love.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2930|cd94cda6.name: Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea
2930|cd94cda6.text: Corruption sneaks into nature's grove.  The forest must be protected at all costs.

3841|ab4871bb.name: Caylais Moonfeather
3841|ab4871bb.text: The Hippogryph is a noble beast, proud and swift.  They are an honor to train, and can quickly take their rider a great distance.

5150|942980f4.name: Nissa Firestone
5150|942980f4.text: Are you a student of the medical sciences?

5171|86b6c1ef.name: Thistleheart
5171|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5172|86b6c1ef.name: Briarthorn
5172|86b6c1ef.text: The arcane only corrupts those who are weak. Keep up on your training, or you may find a similar fate.

5177|5eb7ebc8.name: Tally Berryfizz
5177|5eb7ebc8.text: Who are you and why are you bothering me? Oh, right--potions student. Right. What can I do for you?

5595|293fb776.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|293fb776.text:
A $c, eh...  Well, if you've got a mind to be doing that sort of thing around here then ye best keep yer demons on a leash boyo.  I don't like demons, but I love putting mah axe to them.  Ye get me?  

Now you just leave me be and go get lost in The Forlorn Cavern.  That's where you'll find that $c, Thistleheart.

5595|2fa06dc1.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|2fa06dc1.text:
Yer looking for an Alchemy trainer are ye?  Just came from there, I did.  Ye'll find Ms. Berryfizz over in Tinker Town where the gnomes gather.  

::sigh:: ...why o' why didn't I take the blue potion.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

6382|721fd095.name: Jubahl Corpseseeker
6382|721fd095.text: Want to make your demons more powerful?  It'll cost you, but you've come to the right place.

6737|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Shaussiy
6737|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

97894-complete.name: Gorbold Steelhand
97894-complete.text:
Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.

We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
97894-complete.title: Business in Auberdine

98025-accept.name: Unknown
98025-accept.text:
Attention!

A reward is being offered for the death of the owl "Jai'vhanel" also known as "Swordfeather".

Unfortunately this owl has gone mad and has begun to attack travelers as they journey along the road near Auberdine.

Jai'vhanel was last seen north of the Ameth'Aran ruins near the mountain base. Bring back one of her jet black feathers as proof of her death.

Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

The Auberdine Village Council
98025-accept.title: WANTED: Jai'vhanel
